title: ERA Harness Execution Envelope v0.0.3
description: Outer transport envelope for one completed Harness execution. The nested runtime_record must independently validate against the unchanged v0.0.2 Runtime Record schema.

plan_id.description: Exact plan_id from the frozen v0.0.3 ERA Run Plan.

case_id.description: Exact Case ID executed in this Harness session.

session_id.description: Harness-generated identifier for the isolated fresh session; must be unique per Case within a plan.

runtime_record.description: One complete existing v0.0.2 Runtime Record; validated separately by the importer.
